verdict.rationale: The docs describe the full server-driven path: create an applicant on the backend, create a workflow run that returns an SDK token, collect captures via SDK, and read results via webhook or polling. Smart Capture Link adds an Entrust-hosted redirect journey, and Document plus Facial Similarity reports cover the document-plus-selfie checks. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an embeddable web drop-in component (only mobile SDKs are named), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the integration flow.
